<!-- generated by scripts/sync-docs.mjs — edit the source in the tmvp repo -->
One static binary per OS/arch (macOS, Linux, Windows; amd64 + arm64; `CGO_ENABLED=0`). Install it
once per machine; every product skill on the machine shares it and its warm local server.

```
go install github.com/muthuishere/tmvp/cmd/tmvp@latest      # from source (Go 1.26)
# or in a checkout:
task build        # → bin/tmvp
task cross        # all 6 OS/arch builds → dist/
tmvp version      # version, protocol, registered connector types
```

External CLIs are only needed for the types that drive them, resolved from PATH:
`aws` (aws), `gcloud` (gcp), `az` (az), `git` (git), `playwright-cli` (web browser verbs:
`npm install -g @playwright/cli && playwright-cli install-browser`). Your secret manager's CLI
(`sec`, `op`, `lpass`, `gcloud`, `aws` …) runs the `$(…)` commands in config.

## First skill
```
tmvp new skill acme --systems db:postgres,cluster:k8s,admin:web --envs dev,staging,prod
# → .agents/skills/acme-tmvp/{SKILL.md, config.yaml, assets/}
# fill the $file(sec get REPLACE_ME_… --out ${out}) slots and REPLACE_ME fields, then:
tmvp --skill .agents/skills/acme-tmvp validate
tmvp --skill .agents/skills/acme-tmvp skill lint
tmvp --skill .agents/skills/acme-tmvp check
```
`tmvp skill add <name> <type> [--env prod]` adds a system later; `tmvp skill sync` regenerates
SKILL.md from config.yaml.
